newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PBK BANK 96 NET UP 78 PCT TO PLN 215.3 MLN.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PBK BANK 96 NET UP 78 PCT TO PLN 215.3 MLN.

text.p: The net profit of Poland's Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK), slated for privatisation in the second quarter of this year, jumped 78 percent to 215.3 million zlotys in 1996, PBK's president said on Thursday.
Andrzej Podsiadlo told a news conference the bank expected a pre-tax profit of 420-430 million zlotys in 1997, up from 370.3 million in 1996, which in turn was 46 percent higher than in 1995.
He said PBK's balance sheet total grew 24 percent in 1996 to 9.8 billion zlotys. Its shareholder equity was 763.8 million zlotys, 40 percent more than in 1995.
